rows.text: 🎮 **THE PLAY PROOFS CAMPAIGN (Astra) — AUTHORED 2026-09-25, the queue copy held until the generic census lands (owner, verbatim: "Can you do play proofs using Astra for these maps? That would be good.").** `tasks/sol-play-proofs-1.md` on lane-c (gpt-6-astra, the ChatGPT subscription; the CODEX-WALL lift of the same date names it and every numbered continuation authored from THIS row). The standard is the eight PASS rows of `reviews/sol-map-art-current-status-20260909.md`: a human-shaped boot (the method of `e2e/playability-secure.spec.ts`), the map's OWN terminal (its secure wave with the Claim Secured overlay, or its objective), banked, the Book back, a plain reload keeping the score, zero errors, desktop and phone; drivers under `e2e/native-proofs/<id>.spec.ts` gated behind `GR_NATIVE_PROOF=1`, rows and boards under `artifacts/sol/play-proofs/run-N/`; a map that cannot be finished as designed is a finding F-PP1-n, never an edit. ORDER (nineteen; the Baron and Twin Banks first as Frontier Edition maps): e1-baron, e1-twin-banks, e2-pressure-garden, e2-incline, e3-blackout-ridge, e3-canyon-works, e3-fairground, e4-dust-flats, e4-gusher-county, e4-boneyard, e8-far-side, e8-low-orbit, e8-eclipse, e9-dome-basin, e9-seed-run, e9-devils-alley, e9-old-canal, e10-last-claim, e10-river. Expect three to six maps per run; each drain queues `sol-play-proofs-<N+1>` with the run note's REMAINING LIST until it is empty. Context: the generic census (`map-play-proofs-1`, Opus) found every map boots clean, six secured, none banked, twelve runs unfunded: the kit's limit, not the maps'. GATE per run: READY-FOR-GATES with the maps proven, landed by the attended drain (the status doc resolved by row key). ➡️ **RUN 1 DONE 2026-09-25 (55 min, Astra):** the Incline PROVEN both projects; Blackout Ridge PARTIAL (secured, banked, reloaded; storage goal unproved F-PP1-5); the Baron, Twin Banks and the Pressure Garden HELD after two honest attempts each (F-PP1-1/2/3; a planned third attempt at the campaign's end unless the owner says otherwise). **RUN 2 authored** `tasks/sol-play-proofs-2.md` (Blackout Ridge's goal, then Canyon Works onward; the queue copy follows the run-1 landing). ➡️ **RUN 2 DONE 2026-09-25 (22 min):** no new proof; Blackout Ridge PARTIAL again (F-PP2-1); the Canyon Works blocked by a full-width creek slope derived from the contract and `src/sim/TileHeight.ts` (F-PP2-2, HIGH, a map defect: corrective `canyon-works-traversal-1` to be authored); the Fairground's wheel lost in the opening (F-PP2-3, a hold). **RUN 3 authored** `tasks/sol-play-proofs-3.md` (the Dust Flats onward; the copy follows the run-2 landing). Yield so far: 8 maps attempted, 1 full proof, 1 partial, 1 real defect, 5 holds. ➡️ **RUN 3 DONE 2026-09-25 (21 min):** the three E4 vehicle maps HELD (F-PP3-1/2/3, route and survival limits; the Boneyard's approach tolerance a general driver fix). YIELD F-PP3-4: eleven maps, one proof, one partial, one defect, eight holds. **RUN 4 authored** `tasks/sol-play-proofs-4.md`: a driver CONTROL on the Claim first (a proven map; FAIL stops the campaign for the owner's decision, PASS continues), then the Far Side onward.

🔧 **TWO DRAIN FINDINGS TAKEN UP (attended 2026-09-03 14:4x).** F-2471-1 (pre-existing, control-proven: a half-stamped tape plays on the legacy watch path instead of being refused; `agent-reels.spec.ts:301` red on main): QUEUED lane-c `half-stamped-reel-refusal` (decide the era refusal before choosing the replay path; the red test turns green unweakened). F-2470-1 (the mirror-exposure guard skips tables without a `key` column silently; the refusals table is one): QUEUED lane-d `ledger-exposure-guard-declares-tables` (declare the inspected corpus on the happy path, name skips, harvest declared identity columns). The transfer board's F-2472-3 is already in the fire's own corrective (`transfer-board-v2-registry-outside-engine-corpus`, running lane-b on the held content).

✅ **TRANSFER BOARD — NOW MERGED (s2473 drain, `e1753192f`); THE HOLD BELOW IS DISCHARGED AND IS KEPT ONLY AS PROVENANCE.** The v2 corrective relocated the registry and `computeEngineHash` on the merged tree measures `2a06eb51…a5aecd47`, EQUAL to `assets/engine-era.json`'s era-5 declaration and byte-identical to main (control: main measures the same). No reel is refused `reel_not_current`; L1 ADDITIVE holds. RETIRED HEADLINE FOLLOWS — 🟡🔴 **TRANSFER BOARD — HELD, NOT MERGED (s2472 drain, F-2472-3), AND SUPERSEDED BY A ONE-MOVE CURE.** The lane-b runner STOPPED at its own honesty guard rather than returning READY-FOR-GATES, and it was RIGHT: `assets/contracts` is a WHOLE-DIRECTORY entry in `ENGINE_SOURCE_INPUTS` (`scripts/assay-replay-agent.mjs:38`), so the registry at `assets/contracts/rotation-seeds.json` enters the engine identity corpus. **Control-proven, single variable — exactly 1 of the lane's 13 files is in the corpus:** main `2a06eb51…` (which EQUALS `assets/engine-era.json`'s declared era-5 `engineHash`, so the control asserts its own validity) → with only that file added, `43f54a20…`. Merging as-is refuses **every existing verified reel** as `reel_not_current` and darkens the public board. That violates the ratified spec's own law **L1 ADDITIVE** ("existing tapes, seeds, **eras** and ranking are untouched"), so the path — an incidental choice in a scope list — loses to the law. 🛠️ **THE CURE IS CHEAPER THAN THE ONE THE RUNNER PROPOSED and needs no owner ruling:** it suggested narrowing `computeEngineHash`'s corpus (a judgement about what "the engine" is, and a live desk question). Measured instead: the same file at `assets/rotations/rotation-seeds.json` returns the hash to **`2a06eb51…`, byte-identical to base** — no corpus edit, no era bump, no re-pin. A rotation calendar is door/scheduling data; `assets/contracts` is in the corpus because contract *manifests* define sim behaviour. ➡️ **FIRE-AUTHORED corrective queued lane-b: `transfer-board-v2-registry-outside-engine-corpus.md`** — a **BUILD-ON-PREDECESSOR** master (F-2089-1) declaring all 13 held paths (predicate verified held ⊆ declared, 13/13, before queueing) so the lane's complete implementation is EXTENDED, never `reset --hard` over (Mistake #2). Scope: the `git mv`, its five measured readers (`rotation-mint.mjs` needs nothing — it writes to stdout), and a new guard asserting no rotation registry lives under any corpus entry AND that the computed hash equals the declared one, with a mutation proof. 🔎 **F-2472-4 (non-blocking, for whoever drains v2):** `scripts/skillmd-guard.test.mjs` is now a FOUR-time conflict site and `public/skill.md` gained generated fences this same fire (`9b9397c8e`) — parse the union and count top-level `test(` per line, never diff it (F-2469-1); keep any ROTATION section OUTSIDE the fences. ⚠️ **One attended line, blocking nothing:** `specs/transfer-board.md` still names the old path at `:15`/`:19` and should be amended — a fire does not edit a ratified spec's rulings. Review `reviews/transfer-board.md`.
